title: Writing / Style / Commas
slide_intent: Mark the final item of a list consistently so readers can parse the sequence without an editorial style change.
strategic_value: A simple serial-comma preference can keep Duolingo’s multi-writer copy uniform.
demonstration: The same three-part description appears with and without a comma before the final and.
practical_value: Apply the serial comma when listing three or more items in this historical style.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Place the worked copy in the pale right panel, keeping preference labels and green checks with their examples.

reference_purposes.Application: The preferred example separates all three lesson qualities with the serial comma.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Use the serial, or Oxford, comma.
